title: StaffUI
description: A fully customizable modern staff punishment panel featuring Discord log support, Hex colors, and ItemsAdder compatibility.
body:
🛡️ StaffUI - Professional Staff & Punishment Management Panel
Take your server management to the next level! StaffUI is designed to allow your staff members to perform punishment actions through a fully customizable interface (GUI) without wasting time with complex commands. Developed with the Hazelnut Network infrastructure, this system brings speed and aesthetics together.

✨ Key Features

🎨 Unlimited Customization: Change slot layouts, glass colors, item names, and descriptions in seconds via .yml files.

💎 ItemsAdder Support: Use custom textures and ItemsAdder items in your menus. Fully compatible with custom texture IDs.

🌐 Discord Webhook Integration: Every punishment action (Staff, Target, Reason, and Category) is sent to your Discord channel as a professional Embed message.

🌈 Hex Color Support: Supports all color codes in #FFFFFF format. Reflect your server's corporate identity in the menu.

🚀 Maximum Performance: No database (MySQL/SQLite) setup required. Thanks to its lightweight code structure, it does not cause TPS loss even on the busiest servers.

📦 Standalone Structure: Works with a plug-and-play logic without the need for Vault or any other plugins.

🛠️ Installation Guide

Upload the StaffUI.jar file to your server's plugins folder.

Start the server and wait for the files to be generated.

Paste your Discord Webhook link into the webhook-url section in the config.yml file.

Edit your menus as you wish and activate them with the /cezaver reload command.
